author: Huawei
description: AI is reshaping insurance, but people still come first. In this #Huawei #TransformTalks, Ken Lau, Managing Director of Greater China and Hong Kong CEO of FWD, explains how AI can improve onboarding, underwriting, and claims – yet sophisticated products still need human expertise. For FWD, AI acts as a co-pilot, not a replacement. Learn more to see why keeping people at the center is key to smarter insurance: https://bit.ly/4eOpkFK #ThisIsHuawei #HiFS2026 #AgenticBanking
title: People-Led Decisions Continue to Shape Insurance in the AI Era
